description: Dots end to end: discover, subscribe with verification, an opaque event, canonical claim, renewal, revoke. 2xx is receipt; completion is only a settled claim.

steps.does: server/discover then events/list at protocol version 2026-07-28
events/subscribe with its callback URL and a fresh whsec_ secret
sends one signed verification; the callback echoes the challenge
sends envoi.work_available with an opaque reason, never an id or content
acknowledges 2xx immediately, then runs its event-triggered task which claims over /mcp with the OAuth token (envoi_claim_work)
calls events/subscribe again before refreshBefore with the last cursor: an unchanged renewal inside the cache window sends no new verification
a renewal with a new secret is verified again and signed with both secrets for 600 s
on owner pause sends envoi.control_changed; on revoke ends the subscription and sends nothing more
